name: GOL IBE Search Form
author: srbt

sections.description:
This plugin requires an active contract with C.E.E. Group Travelport a.s. and an active GOL-IBE product. More information is available at https://www.cee-systems.com.

The GOL IBE Search Form plugin allows you to easily embed an advanced flight search form on any page.
It is multilingual and configurable in the admin. After a search, users are redirected to the results page defined in the settings.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Configured and functional GOL-IBE system by C.E.E. Group Travelport a.s.
  • At least 1024px of available container width where the shortcode is placed

Usage

To display the flight search form on any page, simply insert this shortcode into the content editor:
[iforma-golibe]

You can customize the visual style of the search form in Settings → GOL IBE Search to match your website design.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins in WP admin.
  3. Navigate to Settings → GOL IBE Search to configure your client URL and default form language.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Complete plugin rewrite.
  • Modern user interface for the search form.
  • New administration panel with advanced customization options (colors, fonts, gradients).
  • Replaced old architecture with a more stable and secure code base.
  • Simplified asset loading for better performance.
